title: रास्ता पूछना — asking the way
summary: Finding the station on foot. Directions, distance, and asking someone to speak slowly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.translation: Excuse me, where is the station?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: ठीक है। इस सड़क पर सीधे जाइए।
lines.reading: Thīk hai. Is saṛak par sīdhe jāiye.
lines.translation: All right. Go straight along this road.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: बैंक के पास दाईं ओर मुड़िए।
lines.reading: Baink ke pās dāīn or muṛiye.

lines.speaker: B
lines.translation: The station is on the left.

lines.speaker: A
lines.translation: What time is the next train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: मुझे नहीं मालूम। वहाँ पूछ लीजिए।
lines.reading: Mujhe nahīn mālūm. Vahān pūchh lījiye.

vocabulary.meaning: near — a postposition, so it comes after the noun
known — mujhe nahīn mālūm, I don't know

questions.q: Where does he want to go?

questions.explain: baink ke pās — note that ke pās comes after the noun

questions.q: Which side is the station on?
Does she know the train time?
Which phrase asked her to slow down?
